d: Job Summary: Responsible for handling daily cashiering and payment transactions, ensuring accurate cash management, reconciliation, and excellent customer service while following company policies and financial controls.
q: 2–6 years of experience in cashiering, cash management, retail, or customer service.
Higher Secondary, Diploma, or Graduate qualification.
Good knowledge of POS systems and MS Excel.
Strong numerical, coordination, follow-up, and customer service skills.
Ability to work accurately under pressure.
Good communication skills in English; Arabic is an advantage.
Experience in electronics/retail operations will be an added advantage.
r: Process cash, card, cheque, bank transfer, gift card, and voucher transactions through POS.
Manage daily cashier floats and complete cash/teller reconciliation accurately, Zero/low cash discrepancies
Prepare and coordinate cash and cheque bank deposits.
Manage and maintain petty cash and cash withdrawal records.
Maintain accurate staff/customer gift card and Air Miles voucher trackers.
Support cashier shift and roster management.
Capture and maintain accurate customer details in the system.
Handle customer payment-related queries and provide professional service.
Identify and report cash/POS discrepancies and ensure proper documentation.
Follow all company procedures related to cash handling, POS, security, and financial controls.

d: We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarters in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners.
q: Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (MBA preferred).
Minimum 6+ years proven experience in key account management in F&B, SaaS, ERP or Tech industries.
Demonstrated success in driving revenue growth and managing large enterprise accounts.
Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
Strategic thinker with the ability to analyze data, identify trends, and develop actionable insights.
Customer-focused mindset with a passion for delivering exceptional service.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.
Restaurant operations experience is a plus.
r: As a Key Account Manager at Foodics, you will be at the forefront of our business, responsible for managing and nurturing relationships with our enterprise, key clients. You will play a pivotal role in driving revenue growth, ensuring client satisfaction, and expanding our market presence. This position requires a strategic mindset, strong interpersonal skills, and a passion for delivering exceptional service.
Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with enterprise, key clients, understanding their business needs and objectives.
Proactively identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling additional products or services to Foodics existing clients.
Gain a thorough understanding of assigned client’s needs, business objectives and processes to ensure that they successfully adopt and deploy Foodics
Drive revenue growth through effective account management, negotiation, and contract renewals.
Serve as the primary point of contact for key clients, advocating for their needs within the organization and ensuring their satisfaction.
Stay abreast of industry trends, market dynamics, and competitor activities to identify opportunities and mitigate risks.
Boost client retention through enhanced engagement, meeting their needs, exceeding expectations, and delivering exceptional service.
Gather client feedback and insights to inform product development, service enhancements, and process improvements.
Monitor key account metrics, analyze performance data, and prepare regular reports to track progress and identify areas for improvement.
Work closely with cross-functional teams including Sales, Onboarding, Marketing, and Product Development to align strategies and deliver exceptional value to clients.
Provide guidance and support to clients on product usage, troubleshooting, and best practices to maximize their ROI.
Be a voice for the customers internally and help senior leadership understand product concerns, shortcomings, and missing features that are important to the customers.
x: We believe you will love working at Foodics!
We have an inclusive and diverse culture that encourages innovation and flexibility in-offices.
We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares.
We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment.
Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry.
We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.

d: The Physiotherapist will be responsible for assessing, planning, and providing evidence-based physiotherapy care to patients in a long-term care hospital setting. The role involves working closely with a multidisciplinary team (MDT) including physicians, nurses, occupational therapists, and speech therapists to promote patient mobility, independence, and quality of life.
q: Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Physiotherapy from a recognized institution.
Valid NHRA license as a Physiotherapist.
Minimum 6 –8 years’ clinical experience , preferably in long-term care, rehabilitation, or acute hospital settings.
Experience with neurological and geriatric patient populations highly desirable.
Familiarity with modern physiotherapy techniques, rehabilitation equipment, and patient-centered care models.
Strong clinical assessment and treatment planning skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities to work effectively with patients, families, and multidisciplinary teams.
Empathy, patience, and sensitivity to the needs of long-term care patients.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively.
Commitment to continuous learning and professional growth.
r: Conduct comprehensive physiotherapy assessments for patients with chronic conditions, neurological impairments, musculoskeletal disorders, and post-surgical needs.
Develop individualized treatment plans and set measurable goals in collaboration with patients, families, and the MDT.
Deliver therapeutic interventions such as manual therapy, exercise programs, mobility training, respiratory physiotherapy, and use of electrotherapy/rehabilitation equipment.
Support patients with mobility aids (wheelchairs, walkers, prosthetics, orthotics) and train them in safe use.
Provide rehabilitation for patients with long-term conditions (stroke, spinal cord injury, traumatic brain injury, degenerative diseases).
Monitor, evaluate, and document patient progress, adjusting care plans as required.
Educate patients, families, and caregivers on rehabilitation techniques, safe mobility, and long-term condition management.
Participate in discharge planning and ensure continuity of care by liaising with community services where appropriate.
Maintain accurate and timely patient records in line with hospital policies and regulatory standards.
Ensure compliance with infection control, health & safety, and quality standards of the hospital.
Contribute to continuous professional development (CPD) and participate in in-service training, audits, and quality improvement initiatives.
Support the development of physiotherapy protocols, policies, and rehabilitation pathways for the long-term care hospital.

d: We are seeking a highly skilled, proactive, and technically experienced Security Engineer to strengthen and maintain the cybersecurity infrastructure of Crayo Tech Solutions W.L.L. in Bahrain. Working closely with IT management, software developers, infrastructure engineers, system administrators, and external technology partners, the successful candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, monitoring, and maintaining comprehensive security solutions to protect corporate networks, business applications, cloud environments, databases, and sensitive organizational information.

The role requires a technically versatile professional with strong expertise in network security, application security, vulnerability management, threat detection, incident response, and information security governance. The successful candidate will identify emerging cyber threats, conduct security assessments, implement preventive controls, and ensure that technology systems remain secure, resilient, and compliant with relevant industry standards and regulatory requirements.
q: Bachelor's Degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related technical discipline. A Master's Degree in Information Security or Cybersecurity is an added advantage.

3 to 6 years of professional experience in Security Engineering, Information Security, Network Security, or Cybersecurity Operations, preferably within an IT services, software development, telecommunications, or technology consulting environment.
Strong hands-on experience with network security technologies, firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, endpoint protection, SIEM platforms, vulnerability scanners, and security monitoring tools.
Good understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, routing and switching, Windows Server, Linux administration, Active Directory, and enterprise network architecture.
Practical experience with security assessment tools such as Nessus, Qualys, Burp Suite, Wireshark, Nmap, or similar platforms.
Knowledge of cloud security architecture, application security, API protection, database security, encryption, and secure authentication mechanisms.
Experience with incident response, threat intelligence, security event analysis, vulnerability remediation, and cybersecurity risk management.
Strong understanding of security frameworks and compliance requirements, including ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Controls, and relevant industry security standards.
Professional certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CEH, CISSP, CISM, CCSP, or Microsoft/AWS Security certifications are highly advantageous.
Excellent analytical thinking, troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and problem-solving abilities.
Strong written and spoken English communication skills; Arabic proficiency is an added advantage.
r: Design, implement, and maintain enterprise cybersecurity solutions to protect corporate networks, servers, databases, applications, and cloud-based infrastructure.

Configure, administer, and optimize security technologies, including next-generation firewalls, VPNs, intrusion detection and prevention systems (IDS/IPS), endpoint detection and response (EDR), and security information and event management (SIEM) platforms.
Conduct regular vulnerability assessments, penetration testing coordination, security audits, and risk assessments to identify weaknesses across IT infrastructure and software applications.
Monitor network traffic, system logs, endpoint activities, and security alerts to identify suspicious behavior, unauthorized access, malware, and potential cyberattacks.
Investigate security incidents, perform root-cause analysis, coordinate incident containment and recovery, and implement corrective and preventive security measures.

Collaborate with software development teams to integrate secure coding practices, application security testing, DevSecOps principles, and security controls throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
Implement identity and access management (IAM), multi-factor authentication (MFA), privileged access management (PAM), and role-based access controls to safeguard organizational systems.
Strengthen cloud security configurations across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and other hosted environments, ensuring secure deployments, data protection, and infrastructure resilience.
Develop and maintain security policies, technical procedures, incident response plans, disaster recovery documentation, and cybersecurity assessment reports.
Ensure appropriate protection of sensitive customer information, business databases, digital platforms, and third-party integrations.
Coordinate security awareness initiatives and provide technical guidance to employees and IT support teams on cybersecurity best practices.
Evaluate emerging security technologies, recommend infrastructure improvements, and support continuous cybersecurity enhancement initiatives.
Support compliance with relevant information security frameworks and standards, including ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and applicable Bahrain regulatory requirements.
x: Competitive tax-free monthly base salary ranging from BHD 1,000–1,800 , depending on technical qualifications, cybersecurity certifications, and professional experience.
Housing and transportation allowances, depending on the employment package.
Annual performance-based bonus and salary progression opportunities.
Comprehensive medical insurance and statutory end-of-service indemnity in accordance with Bahrain Labour Law.
Annual paid leave and annual return airfare allowance for eligible expatriate employees.
Continuous professional development and sponsorship opportunities for advanced cybersecurity certifications, including CEH, CISSP, CompTIA Security+, and ISO 27001.
Opportunity to work with modern cybersecurity technologies, cloud infrastructure, enterprise applications, and digital security solutions.
Career progression opportunities into Senior Security Engineer, Cybersecurity Architect, Information Security Manager, or Head of Cybersecurity positions.
